主要内容: Sephora and Ulta Beauty, two leading cosmetics retailers, have evolved from distinct market strategies to increasingly similar approaches as consumer demand for makeup grows. Sephora initially focused on luxury cosmetics in urban areas, while Ulta specialized in mass-market products in suburban regions. Both companies are now expanding to capture a larger share of the global color cosmetics market, which is projected to reach $48.3 billion by the end of this year. Their strategies are converging as they compete in a rapidly growing industry. This shift highlights the dynamic nature of the beauty sector and the increasing competition among major players.
